intro_zh: 先听完整课文，再按中文画面线记忆：刚搬进新房子、整个上午一直收拾、书超过一千本、房间相当小、书暂时铺满地板、妹妹帮忙搬书柜、看到满地书后把它叫作漂亮的 carpet，最后说可以 read the carpet。读的时候注意 present perfect continuous 的长句节奏，以及最后笑话前的小停顿。

sentences.text: We have just moved into a new house and I have been working hard all morning. I have been trying to get my new room in order.
sentences.focus_zh: 中文锚点：刚搬进新房子，整个上午一直在努力收拾。have just moved 表示刚刚完成，have been working 和 have been trying 读出一直持续到现在的感觉。
focus_words: get my new room in order

sentences.text: This has not been easy because I own over a thousand books.
sentences.focus_zh: 中文锚点：这并不容易，因为他有一千多本书。own 和 over a thousand 要读清楚，让数量压力出来。

sentences.text: To make matters worse, the room is rather small, so I have temporarily put my books on the floor.
sentences.focus_zh: 中文锚点：更糟糕的是房间相当小，所以他暂时把书放在地板上。To make matters worse 后稍停，temporarily 不要吞音。

sentences.text: At the moment, they cover every inch of floor space and I actually have to walk on them to get in or out of the room.
sentences.focus_zh: 中文锚点：现在书铺满每一寸地板空间，他居然不得不踩着进出。every inch of floor space 是画面核心，actually 读出惊讶感。

sentences.text: A short while ago, my sister helped me to carry one of my old bookcases up the stairs.
sentences.focus_zh: 中文锚点：不久前，妹妹帮他把旧书柜搬上楼。A short while ago 交代时间，helped me to carry 和 bookcases 要连成块读。

sentences.text: She went into my room and got a big surprise when she saw all those books on the floor.
sentences.focus_zh: 中文锚点：妹妹进屋后看到满地的书，大吃一惊。got a big surprise 是自然表达，all those books on the floor 要读出满地书的画面。

sentences.text: This is the prettiest carpet I have ever seen, she said. She gazed at it for some time then added, You don't need bookcases at all.
sentences.focus_zh: 中文锚点：她说这是见过最漂亮的地毯，又盯着看了一会儿，说根本不需要书柜。the prettiest carpet I have ever seen 是最高级重点，not at all 读出加强语气。

sentences.text: You can sit here in your spare time and read the carpet!
sentences.focus_zh: 中文锚点：你可以空闲时坐在这里读地毯。in your spare time 稳稳读，read the carpet 是 punchline，前面可以有一点点期待感。
